original_authors: Original Dispatcharr and redis-rs authors retain application/client credit.
scope: Isolated exact246 plus dropped pure-classification read retry;79 tests including fixture HTTP, not canonical SQL/auth package acceptance.
retry_policy: At most one fresh execution of unchanged CLASSIFY constant after RedisError.is_connection_dropped only. Caller/control/serialization remain owned through first and retry replies. Hardstop skips retry; all non-dropped/server/timeout errors preserved. No heartbeat, CAS, ADMIT, provider, stop, receipt or mutation retry.
limits: Existing controls/body/request/receipt bounds and observer deadline unchanged; at most two constant read operations, no new queues or service caps.
known_open: Canonical replay253/258 first503 requires next image. Controlledidle255 missing provider reservation/admission remains separate. Default recovery OFF; no full M4 or universal active-state recovery claim.
